description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_Injector' used to inject tokens into an HTML document during parsing, providing functionality such as auto-paragraphing, smiley-ification, and linkification within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for preparing the injector, checking required elements, navigating tokens, and handling different token types, serving as a base for concrete injector implementations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector
classes.description: An abstract base class for injecting tokens into an HTML document during parsing, enabling additional processing and modifications like formatting and linkification.

methods.name: rewindOffset
methods.description: Sets the rewind offset for reprocessing tokens, supporting recursive operations.

methods.name: getRewindOffset
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the current rewind offset.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the injector with configuration and context, checking if required elements are available.

methods.name: checkNeeded
methods.description: Verifies that all required elements and attributes are present in the HTML definition.

methods.name: allowsElement
methods.description: Determines whether a specific element is allowed in the current context based on the HTML definition.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Iterator method to move forward through tokens.

methods.name: forwardUntilEndToken
methods.description: Moves forward through tokens until reaching an end token of a specific node, tracking nesting.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Iterator method to move backward through tokens.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Handler invoked on processing text tokens.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handler invoked on processing start or empty element tokens.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handler invoked on processing end tokens, calls notifyEnd.

methods.name: notifyEnd
methods.description: Notifier method called when an end token is processed; read-only token.
